set.body:
Outcome: checked library-owned surface rendering and an explicit embedding distance contract, prerequisite to G1 strict registration.
Scope: new portable align types and tests plus ADR 0019 amendment/evidence. Parent G1 remains open; no ONNX execution registration, StageTrace, production model or private-data work.
Invariants: source text must match its declared representation and frozen view; recall text must come from the checked graph. Scorer payloads contain canonical content and exact submitted strings, no IDs/spans/coordinates or binding accessors. Rendered equality distinguishes different strings; existing lexical/table and historical keys remain unchanged. Refuse invalid UTF-16 bounds/anchors and unsupported media rendering. Metrics declare range/direction and validate finite inputs with no silent clamp; historical scale/parity remains explicit.
Relevant symbols: ContentProjection, SourceRepresentation, RecallGraph.validated, StrictSemanticChannel, ContentCostScoring; ADR0019 S2/S2b-1.
Proposed change: separate unforgeable rendered-content envelope and explicit cosine metric policies; independent boundary design consultation followed by exact-SHA review.
Acceptance: discriminating alias/binding/span/anchor/Unicode/coordinate-invariance tests; outside-package construction/read courts and compiled mutation kills. reference-scope serial fatal-warning gate with totals and format last. Preserve reviewed checkpoint 328e426a (pushed and remote SHA verified). Consumer gate only where types are consumed; no live corpus or efficacy claims.
Risk/escalation: the existing recall policy is hull text, whereas source support may be discontinuous. Make rendering policy explicit rather than change legacy text. No new module/dependency.
Next action: settle minimal input context with independent reviewer, begin narrow paths, implement and gate.
set.title: [G1/S2b-2] Checked surface rendering and explicit embedding metric contract
